Reminders arrive once, with a proper icon.

![OmaCal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omacal/v1.0.2/preview.png)

## Fixed

- **One notification per reminder.** With a bar on more than one monitor, every bar's OmaCal sent the same reminder, so it arrived once per monitor. The first to claim a reminder now sends it and the others stay quiet.
- **Reminders have an icon.** The notification asked for a stock calendar icon that many icon themes don't have, so it often showed none. It now shows a small calendar page in the event's calendar colour, with its day on it.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omacal.git --enable
omarchy plugin disable omarchy.clock
```

Already installed: `omarchy plugin update crmne.omacal`.

OmaCal is an independent project, not created by, affiliated with, or supported by HEY or 37signals.
